LOW.text: Staying motivated is key! Here are some ideas:
tips: Connect with student clubs and organizations
Find a study buddy or accountability partner

MEDIUM.text: Loss of motivation is common but manageable:
tips: Speak with a counselor about motivation
Talk to professors in your major
Join a support group for students

HIGH.text: Your motivation concerns need immediate attention:
tips: Talk to someone you trust immediately
Take a mental health day if needed
